data.value: Painter Yusuf Ndiaye is sending an unsolicited portfolio to Marlin Bay gallery curator Ines Duarte. Will Ines reply with anything beyond an automated acknowledgment within six weeks?

Marlin Bay gallery has a standard process for receiving unsolicited portfolios: they are logged and an automated acknowledgment is sent to the sender. The gallery's email system can send such acknowledgments automatically. Yusuf has the gallery's contact information and can send his portfolio via email or postal mail.
